name: Doll House
source: In Doll House you're renting a giant house with busty roommates. Date and progress through their story lines to unlock them. Piece together the puzzle of your mother's disappearance and bring those responsible to justice.
translation: 在《Doll House》中，你租住在一栋大房子里，与几位丰满的室友同住。与她们约会，推进各自的故事线，逐步解锁更多内容。拼凑母亲失踪的谜团，将幕后责任人绳之以法。
